question: A pipe can fill a tank in 12 hours. Another pipe can empty the filled tank in 14 hours. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, then the time (in hours) in which the tank will be filled is:
solution:
**Given:**

Filling pipe = 12 hours

Emptying pipe = 14 hours

**Formula used:**

If one fills in a hours, other empties in b hours, then net time =

**Calculations:**

⇒ a = 12, b = 14

⇒ Time = (12 × 14) ÷ (14 − 12)

⇒ 168 ÷ 2 = 84

**∴ Tank will be filled in 84 hours.**
